title: Home Oxygen Therapy Rental Agreement Clause — The Payment Cap and Continued Furnishing
content:
# The Payment Cap and Continued Furnishing — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Clause.** Equipment payments for a Home Oxygen Therapy rental stop once the paid months of the current payment period reach the coverage class's oxygen rental cap in months. The cap-reached date is the day after the last day of the final paid month. An equipment month billed beyond the cap is denied as cap reached and is never charged to the patient. Summit Ridge keeps title to the equipment and must keep furnishing and servicing it, without equipment payment, until the coverage class's oxygen useful lifetime in months has elapsed from the first day of the first paid month of the period. Months paid under an earlier coverage or an earlier period do not count toward the cap.

## What counts toward the cap

The paid months of the current payment period are the paid equipment-month lines of the oxygen record under the coverage the record names, whose month began on or after the payment-period start date, up to the handling date, less the reversals recorded against one of those lines.

| Paid month | Counts toward the cap |
|---|---|
| paid under the coverage the record names, in the current payment period, not reversed | yes |
| paid under an earlier coverage | no |
| paid in an earlier payment period | no |
| paid and then reversed | no |

## After the cap

| Question | Answer under this clause |
|---|---|
| Who holds title to the equipment? | Summit Ridge |
| Is the equipment still furnished and serviced? | yes, without equipment payment, until the useful lifetime has elapsed from the first day of the first paid month of the period |
| What happens to an equipment month billed beyond the cap? | it is denied as cap reached and never charged to the patient |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

Suppose a hypothetical coverage class with a cap of 36 months. A rental whose final paid month, month 36, runs from 10 May to 9 June reaches the cap with a cap-reached date of 10 June, the day after the last day of that month. A month 37 billed from 10 June is denied as cap reached and is not charged to the patient.
